dashboard.description: Every listed node's asking price, rented status and rented-at price per GPU class, so providers can price their nodes. DAH-3454.

panels.description: Active nodes in the latest lium-stats snapshot (every 15 minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS "Listed nodes"
FROM executor_price_history
WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT max(snapshot_time) FROM executor_price_history)
  AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
  AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})

panels.title: Listed nodes

panels.description: Nodes with a customer pod in the latest snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rented)::int AS "Rented nodes"
FROM executor_price_history
WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT max(snapshot_time) FROM executor_price_history)
  AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
  AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})

panels.title: Rented nodes

panels.description: Time of the latest node snapshot. Rental prices lag it by up to 30 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(max(snapshot_time) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC' AS "Node list as of"
FROM executor_price_history

panels.title: Node list as of

options.content: Prices are USD per GPU per hour. Paid = what renters pay (price at rental start). Asking = the price a node lists, from a snapshot every 15 minutes (since 16 Sep 2026). Rented = a customer pod runs on the node. Node = first 8 characters of the node id. Pick a GPU class at the top. The time range applies to the charts only: this row and the tables named "now" show the latest snapshot, and the 30-day daily medians always show the last 30 days. In the asking-price panels a group of fewer than 3 nodes is not shown.

panels.description: One row per active node in the latest snapshot. Asking = the price per GPU-hour the node lists now. Rented = a customer pod runs on the node. Rented at = price of the running rental. Rental rows sync every 30 minutes, so for up to 30 minutes a new rental shows no price and an ended rental still shows one.

targets.rawSql:
WITH nodes AS (
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, tier, rented, COALESCE(gpu_count, 0) AS gpu_count, asking_price_per_gpu
  FROM executor_price_history
  WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT max(snapshot_time) FROM executor_price_history)
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
),
open_rental AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (executor_id) executor_id, gpu_type, price_per_gpu, rental_start_time
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE rental_end_time IS NULL
    AND rental_start_time > now() - interval '1 year'
  ORDER BY executor_id, rental_start_time DESC
)
SELECT left(n.executor_id, 8)                          AS "Node",
       n.gpu_type                                      AS "GPU",
       n.tier                                          AS "Tier",
       n.gpu_count                                     AS "GPUs",
       n.asking_price_per_gpu::float8                  AS "Asking, $ per GPU-hour",
       CASE WHEN n.rented THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END     AS "Rented",
       r.price_per_gpu::float8                         AS "Rented at, $ per GPU-hour",
       r.rental_start_time                             AS "Rented since"
FROM nodes n
LEFT JOIN open_rental r USING (executor_id)
WHERE (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR n.gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR n.tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
ORDER BY n.gpu_type, r.price_per_gpu DESC NULLS LAST, n.executor_id

panels.title: Every listed node now ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Percentiles of the price per GPU-hour across rentals running right now, per GPU class.

targets.rawSql:
WITH open_rental AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (executor_id) executor_id, gpu_type, tier, price_per_gpu, rental_start_time
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE rental_end_time IS NULL
    AND rental_start_time > now() - interval '1 year'
  ORDER BY executor_id, rental_start_time DESC
)
SELECT gpu_type                                                             AS "GPU",
       count(*)::int                                                        AS "Rented nodes",
       min(price_per_gpu)::float8                                           AS "min",
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu)::float8  AS "p25",
       percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu)::float8  AS "median",
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu)::float8  AS "p75",
       percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu)::float8  AS "p90",
       max(price_per_gpu)::float8                                           AS "max"
FROM open_rental
WHERE (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
GROUP BY gpu_type
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, gpu_type

panels.title: Rented-at price percentiles now ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Each point is one rental start at the price the renter paid. Change the time range (top right) for 24 h or 7 d.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rental_start_time      AS time,
       gpu_type               AS metric,
       price_per_gpu::float8  AS value
FROM rental_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(rental_start_time)
  AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
  AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rented-at price over time ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Median price per GPU-hour of the rentals that started in each hour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', rental_start_time)                             AS time,
       gpu_type                                                              AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu)::float8    AS value
FROM rental_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(rental_start_time)
  AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
  AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hourly median rented-at price ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Rentals that started in the time range, grouped into up to 12 equal price bands. Pick one GPU class; with All the bands mix classes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT price_per_gpu::numeric AS price
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rental_start_time)
    AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
),
stats AS (
  SELECT min(price) AS lo, max(price) AS hi, count(*)::int AS n FROM r
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT width_bucket(r.price, s.lo, s.hi + 0.000001, LEAST(12, GREATEST(1, s.n))) AS bucket, r.price
  FROM r CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE s.n > 0
)
SELECT concat('$', round(min(price), 2)::text,
              CASE WHEN min(price) = max(price) THEN '' ELSE concat(' - $', round(max(price), 2)::text) END) AS "Price band",
       count(*)::int AS "Rentals"
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY min(price)

panels.title: Rentals per price band ($gpu_type)

panels.description: One point per rental that started in the time range. X = price per GPU-hour, Y = hours the node sat unrented before that rental: since its previous rental ended, or, with no earlier rental, since the node's first snapshot in the 30 days before the rental (a gap over 30 days shows as about 720 h). Rentals whose previous rental is still open, or with neither record, are left out.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, tier, price_per_gpu, rental_start_time, rental_end_time
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE rental_start_time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 days'
    AND rental_start_time < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  UNION ALL
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, tier, price_per_gpu, rental_start_time, rental_end_time
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE (rental_end_time IS NULL OR rental_end_time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 days')
    AND rental_start_time <= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 days'
    AND rental_start_time > now() - interval '1 year'
),
r AS (
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, tier, price_per_gpu, rental_start_time,
         lag(rental_end_time)   OVER (PARTITION BY executor_id ORDER BY rental_start_time) AS prev_end,
         lag(rental_start_time) OVER (PARTITION BY executor_id ORDER BY rental_start_time) AS prev_start
  FROM src
),
w AS (
  SELECT * FROM r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rental_start_time)
    AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
),
idle AS (
  SELECT w.*,
         CASE WHEN w.prev_start IS NOT NULL THEN w.prev_end
              ELSE (SELECT min(h.snapshot_time) FROM executor_specs_history h
                     WHERE h.executor_id = w.executor_id
                       AND h.snapshot_time > w.rental_start_time - interval '30 days')
         END AS free_since
  FROM w
)
SELECT left(executor_id, 8)                                                          AS "Node",
       gpu_type                                                                      AS "GPU",
       price_per_gpu::float8                                                         AS "Rented at, $ per GPU-hour",
       round((extract(epoch FROM (rental_start_time - free_since)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2)::float8 AS "Hours idle before rent",
       rental_start_time                                                             AS "Rented at"
FROM idle
WHERE free_since IS NOT NULL AND free_since <= rental_start_time
ORDER BY rental_start_time DESC

panels.title: Hours idle before rent vs rented-at price ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Per GPU class in the latest node snapshot: listed nodes, nodes with a customer pod, and the median asking price of the unrented nodes next to the median price the running rentals pay (the price at rental start; a node can change its asking price while rented). Classes with fewer than 3 listed nodes are not shown; a median over fewer than 3 nodes is left blank.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, rented, asking_price_per_gpu
  FROM executor_price_history
  WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT max(snapshot_time) FROM executor_price_history)
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
),
open_rental AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (executor_id) executor_id, gpu_type, price_per_gpu
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE rental_end_time IS NULL
    AND rental_start_time > now() - interval '1 year'
    AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY executor_id, rental_start_time DESC
),
paid AS (
  SELECT gpu_type, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu) AS med_paid
  FROM open_rental
  GROUP BY gpu_type
  HAVING count(DISTINCT executor_id) >= 3
)
SELECT s.gpu_type                                                                        AS "GPU",
       count(*)::int                                                                     AS "Listed nodes",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.rented)::int                                             AS "Rented nodes",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.rented) / count(*), 0)::float8             AS "Rented share",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.rented AND s.asking_price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL) >= 3
            THEN percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.asking_price_per_gpu)
                   FILTER (WHERE NOT s.rented AND s.asking_price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL)::float8 END AS "Median asking, unrented nodes",
       p.med_paid::float8                                                                AS "Median paid, rented nodes"
FROM snap s
LEFT JOIN paid p USING (gpu_type)
GROUP BY s.gpu_type, p.med_paid
HAVING count(*) >= 3
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, s.gpu_type

panels.title: Asking price vs paid price now ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Per GPU class and day: the median asking price of the unrented nodes (15-minute snapshots) against the median price paid by the rentals running that day (price at rental start). A day with fewer than 3 nodes on a side is left blank. Always the last 30 days, whatever the time range. Pick one GPU class to compare the two lines.

targets.rawSql:
WITH asking AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', snapshot_time) AS time, gpu_type,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_price_per_gpu) AS med,
         count(DISTINCT executor_id) AS nodes
  FROM executor_price_history
  WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_time)
    AND extract(epoch FROM snapshot_time)::bigint % 21600 = 0
    AND NOT rented
    AND asking_price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
paid AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', snapshot_time) AS time, gpu_type,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu) AS med,
         count(DISTINCT executor_id) AS nodes
  FROM rental_snapshots
  WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_time)
    AND extract(epoch FROM snapshot_time)::bigint % 21600 = 0
    AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM executor_price_history h WHERE h.executor_id = rental_snapshots.executor_id AND h.snapshot_time > rental_snapshots.snapshot_time - interval '15 minutes' AND h.snapshot_time <= rental_snapshots.snapshot_time AND h.tier = ${tier:sqlstring}))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT time, gpu_type || ' - asking, unrented' AS metric, med::float8 AS value FROM asking WHERE nodes >= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT time, gpu_type || ' - paid, rented' AS metric, med::float8 AS value FROM paid WHERE nodes >= 3
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Asking price vs paid price, daily medians, 30 days ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Rentals that started in the time range on a node whose earlier rental (within the 30 days before) had ended. Hours unrented = from the end of that earlier rental to the start of this one. The node's asking price in the last snapshot before the start (up to 30 minutes back) is compared with the median asking price of the unrented nodes of its GPU class in that snapshot (at least 3 of them, else the rent is left out): below (under 95 %), at (95 to 105 %), above (over 105 %). A band with fewer than 3 nodes is not shown. Snapshots exist since 16 Sep 2026.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, tier, rental_start_time, rental_end_time
  FROM rental_history
  WHERE rental_start_time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 days'
    AND rental_start_time < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
    AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring})
),
r AS (
  SELECT executor_id, gpu_type, tier, rental_start_time,
         lag(rental_end_time) OVER (PARTITION BY executor_id ORDER BY rental_start_time) AS prev_end
  FROM src
),
rents AS (
  SELECT * FROM r
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rental_start_time)
    AND prev_end IS NOT NULL AND prev_end <= rental_start_time
    AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
),
asked AS (
  SELECT w.executor_id, w.gpu_type, w.rental_start_time, w.prev_end, a.snapshot_time, a.asking_price_per_gpu
  FROM rents w
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT h.snapshot_time, h.asking_price_per_gpu
    FROM executor_price_history h
    WHERE h.executor_id = w.executor_id
      AND h.snapshot_time <= w.rental_start_time
      AND h.snapshot_time > w.rental_start_time - interval '30 minutes'
      AND h.asking_price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY h.snapshot_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) a
),
class_median AS (
  SELECT h.snapshot_time, h.gpu_type,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY h.asking_price_per_gpu) AS med
  FROM executor_price_history h
  WHERE (h.snapshot_time, h.gpu_type) IN (SELECT DISTINCT snapshot_time, gpu_type FROM asked)
    AND NOT h.rented
    AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR h.tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
    AND h.asking_price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING count(*) >= 3
),
classed AS (
  SELECT a.executor_id,
         extract(epoch FROM (a.rental_start_time - a.prev_end)) / 3600.0 AS hours_unrented,
         CASE WHEN a.asking_price_per_gpu < 0.95 * m.med THEN '1 Below class median (< 95 %)'
              WHEN a.asking_price_per_gpu > 1.05 * m.med THEN '3 Above class median (> 105 %)'
              ELSE '2 At class median (95-105 %)' END AS band
  FROM asked a
  JOIN class_median m ON m.snapshot_time = a.snapshot_time AND m.gpu_type = a.gpu_type
)
SELECT substr(band, 3)                                                                       AS "Asking price",
       count(*)::int                                                                          AS "Rents",
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hours_unrented)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS "Median hours unrented before rent",
       round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hours_unrented)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS "p75 hours"
FROM classed
GROUP BY band
HAVING count(DISTINCT executor_id) >= 3
ORDER BY band

panels.title: Hours unrented before rent, by asking price against the class median ($gpu_type)

panels.description: Per GPU class and hour: nodes with a customer pod as a share of the listed nodes in the snapshot taken on the hour. Hours with fewer than 3 nodes in a class are left blank. Reads at most the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', snapshot_time)                                        AS time,
       gpu_type                                                                        AS metric,
       (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE rented) / count(*))::float8                     AS value
FROM executor_price_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(snapshot_time)
  AND snapshot_time > now() - interval '30 days'
  AND extract(epoch FROM snapshot_time)::bigint % 3600 = 0
  AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
  AND rented IS NOT NULL
  AND (${gpu_type:sqlstring} = 'All' OR gpu_type = ${gpu_type:sqlstring}) AND (${tier:sqlstring} = 'All' OR tier = ${tier:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING count(DISTINCT executor_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Share of listed nodes rented, hourly ($gpu_type)

list.definition:
SELECT 'All' UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT gpu_type
FROM executor_price_history
WHERE snapshot_time = (SELECT max(snapshot_time) FROM executor_price_history)
  AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1)
